clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken priests in the Undercity learn Devouring Plague from Priestess Aelthalyste. The rite is for those who have proven their dedication to shadow magic, and teaches a feared curse of the undead priesthood.

In the Undercity’s War Quarter, Priestess Aelthalyste teaches Forsaken priests the grim arts of the Shadow. Priests of other races draw power from the Holy Light or ancestral spirits, but the Forsaken have shaped their own spiritual doctrines. Devouring Plague gives form to that path: it torments foes and drains their stolen vitality to sustain the caster’s decaying body.

Priestess Aelthalyste shares the plague’s power only with care. The spell is a weapon of potent malice, meant to turn the tide against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. As she teaches it, she warns her disciples to practice until their command is sure. Greater trials await those who seek mastery of the dark arts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, friend. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
